notes.title: Update 1.0.2 : Mid-Save Feature
notes.content:
Hello.
A mid-save feature has been added.
The game will automatically save after clearing the first sector, and you can continue playing from where you left off even after quitting the game.

※ You will start from the beginning of the sector you exited.

[b]System Changes
[/b]
Research: Removed the prerequisite conditions for higher-tier research.
You can now freely conduct research.

[b]Balance Adjustments
[/b]

Military Drones
[list]
[*] Gatling Tower Attack Power: 60 → 65
[*] Flame Tower Attack Power: 140 → 150
[*] Flame Tower Penetration: 25 → 30
[/list]

Desert Drones
[list]
[*] Eagle Tower Attack Power: 120 → 130
[/list]


The health of enemies at all difficulty levels has been reduced.


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Removed the feature where elite monsters could knock down characters.
[*] Fixed a bug where cores were consumed when upgrading parts.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 : Game Speed Up Feature
notes.content:
Speed Up Feature Added
You can toggle the speed up feature on or off by pressing the 'T' key.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed sound effects that were not being adjusted by the volume control.
[*] Improved accuracy when hammering on monster corpses.
[*] Fixed abnormal wave information display upon mission failure.
[*] Corrected the elite effects that were displaying incorrectly.
[/list]

notes.title: 'ReRoad' v1.0 out now
notes.content:
Hello, this is Rabbit Hole Games.

We are excited to announce that 'ReRoad' has officially launched. The game price remains the same in the official version.

The main changes since ReRoad's early access launch are as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37790317/890dbd9327b31629b9d2a7874350c6b3534eaa20.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added final boss monster
[*] Added 3 new skills for each drone
[*] Added 3 new difficulty
[*] Approximately 40 inventions added
[*] 1 type of challenge mode added
[*] Added character costume change function
[*] Added research system
[*] Tower-specific parts mode system added
[*] Added new drone and towers
[/list]


We deeply appreciate all the support and anticipation from everyone. However, we sincerely apologize for the long delay in the official release due to economic and practical difficulties.

To repay everyone who has waited, we have done our best to prepare the official release update.

We apologize once again for the delay and sincerely thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
The Rabbit Hole Games Team

notes.title: Delete Tower Breakdown & Wave-to-Wave Time !
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Jane finally succeeded in developing a tower that [b]won't break down[/b]!

In this update, we've seen a lot of your feedback. 

[b]'Tower Breakdown'[/b] and [b]'Wave-to-Wave Time'[/b] has been deleted.

I saw that the system, which I thought was an element of more immersion in the battlefield, made many users feel a lot of inconvenient.
We reorganized the game so that we can focus on other factors than repair.


[h2]Delete Tower Breakdown[/h2]

The tower has now been modified so that it does not break itself, but only because of the boss, the elite, or the invention.

Also, the various effects related to the breakdown have been modified because the above situation does not usually break.
(Revised items are marked at the bottom of the update.)

[h2]Delete Wave-to-Wave Time[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37790317/b6436b2db26d45ed5887c5ebca742e0c47994b1a.gif[/img]
Now you can start the next wave on your own when you're ready.

In the meantime, if the next wave had to be pushed constantly and move busily, now I've revised it to think slowly and prepare for the next wave.

[h2]Dismantling enemy wreckage[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37790317/2acfcb66ccf5406f083bbdde0f0f0648b6c3509e.gif[/img]
Eliminate the enemy robots and occasionally leave unexploded wreckage of the enemy.

From the enemy's wreckage, valuable resources such as scrap/core/upgrade kits are dropped.

After the wave, collect the resources and prepare for the next wave!

[h2]Delete Tower Properties[/h2]

In the meantime, the tower with the 'special' property was causing 1.5 times the damage to the 'Robonoids', but it was difficult to play with consciousness and seemed to be a confusing element, so the property system was deleted.

[h2]Play restructuring[/h2]

The breakdown system has been deleted, reducing the player's work to do while in the wave.
So we reduced some skill cool time of drones to allow more intervention in combat with enemies.


[h2]Modifications[/h2]

[h3]Drone[/h3]

[b]Supplied Drone[/b]
[list]
[*] E skill : cool time 20 seconds -> 10 seconds
[/list]

[b]Military drone [/b]
[list]
[*] Q Skill: Switch the attribute of the tower within the range to Special for 5 seconds and increase attack speed by 10%. -> 15% increase in attack speed of towers in range for 5 seconds. Cool time 15 seconds -> 10 seconds
[/list]

[b]Desert Drone[/b]
[list]
[*] E skill : Damage 300/600/900 -> 200/400/600
[/list]

[h3]Tower[/h3]

[b]Laser Tower [/b]
[list]
[*] Attack Power 200 -> 250
[/list]

[b]Scorpion Tower [/b]
[list]
[*] Attack Power 300 -> 400
[*] scrap metal required 10 -> 11
[/list]

[b]Eagle Tower [/b]
[list]
[*] Delete 'Breakdown Immunity' from 'Isolated' effect
[/list]

[h3]Invention[/h3]

[b]Modify[/b]
[list]
[*] Breakdown-inducing Device : Increased tower failure frequency -> Random towers breakdown every 30 seconds. increases the damage of all towers by 4%. (Max 20%)
[*] Sturdy Safe : Increase penetration of all towers by half the current core ->Increases all towers’ PEN by half the number of towers.
[/list]

[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*] Waste Box: 4% chance of finding an invention from the enemy's wreckage.
[*] Weakness Analyzer: Twice the damage every tower does to enemies with less than 10% HP.
[*] Emergency hammer: When dismantling enemy wreckage, the Demolish count increases by 1 with a 10% chance.
[/list]

[b]Delete[/b]
[list]
[*] Tower washer: 50% increase in 'new' duration 
[/list]

[h3]Monsters[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sector 2 Pirate Monster: The pattern of probability breaking the tower that destroyed him was deleted.
[*] Sector 2 Side Monsters: No longer recognized as monsters, only activate patterns once per wave.
[/list]

[h3]Others[/h3]
[list]
[*] 'Mint Condition': 50% ->25% increase in attack speed for 5 seconds after tower is repaired.
[/list]

We hope you all have a great Lunar New Year :)

In this update, prior to the next drone addition,

you can specialize the towers even further 

by using the Mode System where you can choose modes when adding Parts.


[h2]Mode System[/h2]


Players can choose one of the two modes when they initially add Parts, and additional components are added to the tower accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37790317/0f8445b36a4801ece77ce136a1300e4197b715fd.gif[/img]

[*] Gatling Tower : Explosive Barrel / Chemical Launch Pod

[*] Grenade Tower : Double Flasher / Explosive Amplifier

We added/improved more visual effects and sounds to each Parts Upgrade to make them more entertaining.

Try out the new attractive towers with additional components and effect improvements!

Thank you!

notes.title: Early Access Update v1.2 : Balance patch, Special Supply/Research added
notes.content:
Hello!
[b]We wish everyone a Happy New Year.[/b]

In this update, we’ve added a [b]Research[/b] system and [b]Special Supply[/b] system, in addition to the balance patch.

[h2]Wave Reduction & Decreased Difficulty[/h2]
We’ve received some feedback that playing 3 sectors simultaneously was quite taxing,
[u][b]so we’ve reduced the length of sectors from 15 waves to 12 waves.[/b][/u]

We’ve also reflected upon feedback about the difficulty being too high, and in order to provide better gameplay,
we’ve made some [u][b]balancing modifications[/b][/u] and added [u][b]new contents[/b][/u].


[h2]Research[/h2]
Obtain a Research Point upon clearing a sector, up to a total of 30 points.
Commission Jane to research by using Research Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37790317/37723c2860ecf00048bd3e6cc211e9f6965085f1.gif[/img]
[*] Coating Drill : Increases vehicle durability by 1/2/3/4/5 % 
[*] Disburdening Shoes : Increases Movement Speed by 3/6/9/12/15 %
[*] Hammer Enhancement : Increases Build / Repair Speed by 3/6/9/12/15 %
[*] Scrap Recycling : Increases the chance of obtaining Scraps by 1/2/3/4/5 %
[*] Core Extraction : Increases the chance of obtaining Cores by 1/2/3/4/5 %

[*] Innovation : 5/10/15 % % chance to enhance to level 4 when reaching Parts Upgrade effect level 3.
[*] Lens Crafting : 3/6/9 % % chance to find another invention when eliminating an Elite Monster.
[/list]


[h2]Special Supply[/h2]
Drones will provide a Special Supply at the beginning of a certain wave.
Special Supply will assist you in clearing the game through the choices you make for each situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37790317/3eb39d4a4c54e9442a99b66bdca8ef1f4a83238d.gif[/img]

notes.title: Early Access Update v1.0.11
notes.content:
Hello, this is Rabbithole Games!

Some bugs found in v1.0.1 have been modified.

bug fix

- Pumping motor: The kit acquisition criteria have been changed to 5->4 acquisitions, but the text has not been changed.

- Sector 2 bosses have stuck by inhibitor objects.

- Sector 3 bosses have pushed by player characters.

- Sector 3 corrected the attack that did not repeat itself.

- In the 'Mechanical Balloon' challenge mode, we corrected the appearance of special monsters on the 2nd stage side with the shield UI turned off for the first time.

- In 'Mechanical Balloon' challenge mode, special monsters appearing on the 2nd stage side have been corrected to be damaged by physical force, not by a barrier.  Now you can remove 50 shields when you apply them to special monsters.

Thank you for all the bug reports. 
I apologize for causing inconvenience to your play.

Thank you!

notes.title: Early Access Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello!
Upon launch, we received feedback from users to modify some of the bugs and balance some strongly or weakly designed content.

Bug Fix

Machine-generated stamp: The phenomenon of multiple charging stations overlapping has been corrected.
We corrected the overlapping phenomenon of 2 sector boss monsters.
We have corrected the effect of zero attack by upgrading certain characteristics of the Yutan Tower part.
We corrected the abnormalities that occur when the production window is closed with the ESC key during craft to the crafting drone.


Balance Adjustment

Military Drone
  Tower
- Flame Tower: critical strike rate 20%  -> 25%
- Gatling Tower: critical strike rate 5% -> 10%
- Yutan Tower: critical strike rate 5% -> 15%

Invention
- Machine-generated stamp: 20% -> 15% chance of charging station creation 
- Pumping motor: Each time acquire 5->4 kits, get 1 more

Elite Monster
- Overcharged Battery : The time to knock out the tower has increased slightly.
- Monster's HP increased slightly in 2 and 3 sectors of "Overcharged Battery"
- Monster's HP increased slightly in 2 and 3 sectors of "Shape Memory Alloys"
- Monster's HP reduced slightly in 3 sector of "Absolute Armor"
